Definition
[Fundamental solution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0416 1. appe:1.8\group Heat Kernels

A fundamental solution $h(x,y,t)$ is continuous, $C^2$ in $x$, $C^1$ in $t$, satisfies $(\partial _t-\Delta _x)h=0$, and converges to $\delta _y$ as $t\downarrow 0$ against compactly supported continuous test functions.
